title: runstate's maintenance control arm fails on this host at base, proving nothing
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo fails at the base commit on this host (verified by stash): the fixture's control — 'a plain git fetch in the armed repository started no maintenance' — does not hold for this host's git, so the test cannot distinguish the store's behaviour. Unrelated to npq; a host-version guard or a relaxed control arm would make the test honest on hosts whose git does not auto-maintain on fetch.
